title: Inverse image comparison for free module sheaves
statement: Let $f$ be a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism] between sheaf categories on small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal B$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ (equivalently, on the $\mathcal C$-side of $f$). For any sheaf of sets $\mathcal E$ on $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$, the left-exact left adjoint $f^{-1}$ has a canonical natural isomorphism from the inverse image of the free $\mathcal B$-module sheaf on $\mathcal E$ to the free $f^{-1}\mathcal B$-module sheaf on $f^{-1}\mathcal E$ in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. It carries every canonical free generator to the corresponding inverse-image generator and is compatible with finite products and composition of geometric morphisms.

source.place: Tag 08TQ, lemma-pullback-differentials and proof (free-module relation-map comparison under exact inverse image); the free-module comparison is the coproduct/adjunction calculation in the displayed construction.
